*We have 5.1 Crore Cases Pending. We have 1 Lakh Temples. But we have ZERO Mediators in every village.*

*That is the real problem of Viksit Bharat.*

I am *Thillainayagam Sankaravel*, President, MedArb International.

I am not building another Law Firm.

*I am building India's First RESOLUTION ARMY.*

*VISION 2030: 1 LAKH MEDIATORS FOR 1 BILLION RESOLUTIONS.*

Judges give Dates.
Mediators give Solutions.

*I will develop 6 Types of Mediators - Not Lawyers:*

*1. YUVA MEDIATOR 🎓*
_25,000 Students_
They won't fight in canteen. They will mediate.
From Class Fights to Board Fights.

*2. SHE RESOLVES + POSH MEDIATOR 👩‍⚖️*
_10,000 Women Mediators_
Don't give her charity. Give her GAVEL.
She will resolve POSH complaints through Conciliation, not just Committees. She will resolve family disputes before they reach court. When a woman mediates, a village unites.
_CSR + POSH Act, 2013 Compliant_

*3. SHRAM SAMADHAN MEDIATOR 👷*
_15,000 Workplace Mediators_
70% people don't leave job. They leave unresolved conflict.
They will bring Harmony at Work.

*4. ESG MEDIATOR 🌳*
_10,000 Community & Environment Mediators_
Your factory has 100% pollution control, but 0% community control.
SEBI asks for BRSR. Investors ask for ESG Score.
These mediators will stop your next protest, resolve your land dispute & make your ESG Report GREEN before it becomes RED.
_ESG - E & S Compliant_

*5. POSH SAMADHAN MEDIATOR ⚖️*
_5,000 Certified POSH Conciliators_
Every ICC needs a Conciliator as per Section 10 of POSH Act. Not just enquiry.
We develop certified POSH Conciliators who resolve complaints with dignity, save your brand & ensure 100% POSH Compliance.
_POSH Act + S in ESG Compliant_

*6. VYAPARA MEDIATOR 💼*
_40,000 Chamber Mediators_
MSMEs don't need loan. They need dues back in 30 days, not 10 years.
1 Mediator for 1 Chamber. That is Vyapara Samadhan Kendra.
_ESG - G Compliant_

*MY FORMULA: 1 Mediator = 100 Disputes Resolved = 100 Families Saved.*

*Cost to build 1 Mediator = Rs. 25,000 = Cost of 1 Court Hearing.*

*Best ROI in CSR History:*

✅ Schedule VII Compliant
✅ POSH Act, 2013 Compliant
✅ ESG - BRSR Compliant (E, S & G)
✅ Mediation Act, 2023 Compliant

*MY OPEN CHALLENGE TO ALL CORPORATES, CHROs & CHAMBERS:*

Stop spending 2% on flex banners.

Invest 2% to build 100 POSH & ESG Mediators for YOUR district.

Your Logo on their badge.
Your Name in National Registry.
Your Story in their every Resolution.

_"Proudly Developed by CSR of [Your Company Name]"_

In 2047, every company will have 4 people:
HR, Auditor, Lawyer... and a *MEDIATOR.*

Will that Mediator be built by YOU?

*Comment "I WILL BUILD"*

Let's Talk. Let's Resolve.

*Thillainayagam Sankaravel*
President - MedArb International | Founder - The Resolution Economy
